value.rationale: This is a natural full parameter classification on the fundamental connected clique-windmill/block graph family, revealing two different sphere degrees in the nontrivial intermediate regime \(2\le r<s\) and a canonical integral automorphism module across all parameters. These refine generic chordal wedge results and field-Betti/regularity formulas and are useful for distinguishing symmetry invisible to Betti ranks.
